# MockupWall

> AI wall art mockup generator and gallery wall designer for iOS.

MockupWall is the website for Wallapp – Gallery Wall Designer, an iOS app that places your artwork, prints, posters, and photography into realistic interior scenes — with accurate frames, lighting, shadows, and true-to-size scale — in seconds. Built for artists, Etsy art sellers, print-on-demand shops, photographers, galleries, and interior designers who need in-context product images without a photoshoot.

## Key Features

- Wall art mockup generator — place your art in a realistic room from one photo
- True-to-scale placement — enter real dimensions so the size reads correctly
- Thousands of interior scenes (homes, galleries, offices, seasonal), updated regularly
- Upload your own room or wall photo to place art exactly where it will hang
- Customizable frames, mats, edge colors, walls, floors, and textures
- Automatic lighting, shadow, and color matching for a photoreal result
- Gallery wall / grid layouts with multiple artworks
- Built-in wall paint color visualizer
- AI art video — turn a mockup into a short showcase clip for social
- High-resolution export for listings, ads, print, and promotion
- 100% mobile — iPhone and iPad, no desktop needed

## Who Uses It

Artists and illustrators, Etsy art-print sellers, print-on-demand (POD) wall-art stores, photographers selling fine-art prints, galleries and art dealers, and interior designers.

## Platform

- iOS only (iPhone and iPad)
- Free to download; premium features via subscription (weekly or lifetime)
- Available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wallapp-gallery-wall-designer/id6800613900
